facts.fact: Statutory Instrument No. 8 of 2019 (gazetted 17 October 2019) sets up the Universal Access Development Fund under the Telecommunications Act 2006 and charges service providers a universal access and service levy of 0.75 per cent of gross income, to finance universal service programmes and projects; the document gives no collection or payment figures.
facts.system: Universal Access Development Fund (universal access and service levy)

systems.owner: National Telecommunications Commission; Board of Trustees and Fund Administrator

note: Dated 2019, so no budget fact; no collections or spending stated.
